Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.dbmanager.jdbc

Class QueryExecutor

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.dbmanager.jdbc.QueryExecutor
public final class QueryExecutor extends Object
Runs SQL against a live connection and captures the outcome into an immutable QueryResult, applying a fetch size, a query timeout and a hard row cap.

One executor instance is bound to one logical query session: it remembers the currently running Statement so cancel() can interrupt it from another thread (the UI's Stop button). All execute methods are blocking and must run off the Swing EDT.

    • execute

      public QueryResult execute(Connection conn, String sql, int rowLimit)
      Executes a single statement.
      Parameters:
      conn - an open connection
      sql - the statement text
      rowLimit - a per-query row cap; <=0 falls back to the settings cap
      Returns:
      the result (never null); a driver error is captured, not thrown

    • executeScript

      public List<QueryResult> executeScript(Connection conn, String script, int rowLimit)
      Splits a script and executes each statement in order.
      Parameters:
      conn - an open connection
      script - one or more semicolon-separated statements
      rowLimit - the per-query row cap (<=0 uses the settings cap)
      Returns:
      one result per statement; execution stops early if cancelled
